step_results.result: UIAI opened the generated Workspace live-refresh surface at 1440x1000 with an exact-scope SSE connection.
The generated action linked one stable artifact through revision 2; the subscribed surface rendered revision 2.
The client disconnected after cursor 9, replayed the missed revision at cursor 10, tolerated duplicates, and waited for state_version 10 before refetching.
The Attachment B event at durable sequence 11 was excluded by the Attachment A stream and surfaceBRenders remained zero.
At 390x844, scrollWidth remained 390 and the primary action remained 324 pixels wide.

Final diagnostics had zero console errors, zero exceptions, zero HTTP 4xx, and zero HTTP 5xx; three status-200 ERR_ABORTED records were expected client-owned SSE closes during reconnect and completion.
The client closed its final stream; the UIAI page and temporary proof processes are independently disposable.
